problem: Consider the matrix given by $L=[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ 4 & -2 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}].$ Determine the value of $k$ for which the vector $b=[\begin{aligned}k-11 \\ -10 \\ 5\end{aligned}]$ belongs to $\text{Col}(L).$

activity_context.topic_title: The Column Space of a Matrix

feedback.problem:
The matrix $E$ and the vector $b$ are given below.
Determine if $b\in \text{Col}(E).$ 
In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}\cdot {x}_{3}\cdot {x}_{4}$, where ${x}_{1}$, ${x}_{2}$, ${x}_{3}$, and ${x}_{4}$ are real numbers such that $b={x}_{1}{e}_{1}+{x}_{2}{e}_{2}+{x}_{3}{e}_{3}+{x}_{4}{e}_{4},$ and ${e}_{1}$, ${e}_{2}$, ${e}_{3}$, and ${e}_{4}$ are respective columns of $E.$

$$
E=[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & 7 & 1 \\ 4 & -16 & 28 & 4 \\ 1 & -3 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 7 \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
In order to determine whether $b$ lies in $\text{Col}(E),$ we need to check if the equation $Ex=b$ is consistent. So, let's find the row echelon form of the augmented matrix $[E\,|\,b]$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[E\,|\,b] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & 7 & 1 & 2 \\ 4 & -16 & 28 & 4 & 7 \\ 1 & -3 & 0 & -1 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-4){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & 7 & 1 & 2 \\ \text{ }0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & -3 & 0 & -1 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-4{x}_{2}+7{x}_{3}+{x}_{4}=2 \\ 0=-1 \\ {x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}-{x}_{4}=0.\end{aligned}
$$

From the second equation, we get a false statement $0=-1.$ Therefore, the system is inconsistent, and we conclude that $b\notin \text{Col}(E).$
